items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that's Sam Charter's book. ... Do you mind giving your full name... [INTERVIEWEE] I know that too.

ctx.x: I'll make a note to start here that we're interviewing Mr. Albert Francis at his home at 1922. Mandeville, yeah. Mandeville Street downtown New Orleans and this is Bill Russell. You made this book? I've read most of that. I thought you didn't know about Russell? No, no, that's Sam Charter's book. He's supposed to view some of the notes that Dick Allen took. Maybe if Dick ever talked to you, you might have some notes from him too in there. Do you mind giving your full name, your middle name and all? Albert F.…
